title: بوجاتي W16 مسترال بلانك إتيرنال: تحفة بورسلين فريدة تمزج الفن والهندسة
author: Top Gear Middle East; محمد مكحل
text:
في عالم السيارات الخارقة، اعتدنا رؤية ألياف الكربون والتيتانيوم والألمنيوم الفاخر. أما بوجاتي فقد قررت هذه المرة الذهاب في اتجاه مختلف تماماً، لتقدم لنا سيارة تبدو وكأنها خرجت من معرض بيكاسو للفنون الراقية..
تعرّف إلى بوجاتي W16 مسترال بلانك اتيرنال (Bugatti W16 Mistral Blanc Éternel)، النسخة الخاصة والفريدة من نوعها، القادمة بلمسات مصنوعة من البورسلين الحقيقي (Porcelain)، في واحدة من أغرب وأجمل إبداعات العلامة الفرنسية خلال السنوات الأخيرة.
بدأت القصة قبل 15 عام، عندما تعاونت بوجاتي مع شركة Königliche Porzellan-Manufaktur Berlin (KPM) الألمانية المتخصصة في صناعة البورسلين الفاخر لإنتاج صيغة خاصة من فيرون جراند سبورت (Veyron Grand Sport). واليوم، يعود هذا التعاون مرة أخرى، لكن مع واحدة من أهم طرازات بوجاتي في العصر الحديث، W16 Mistral.
خرجت السيارة الجديدة من برنامج التخصيص الشهير Bugatti Sur Mesure، وهي أكثر من مجرد نسخة استثنائية. إذ تمثل احتفال بمحرك أسطوري، بعد أن اقترب من نهاية رحلته في أروقة مصانع الشركة الفرنسية.
بورسلين حقيقي في الداخل والخارج! نعم، قرأت ذلك بشكل صحيح. فبدلاً من استخدام البورسلين كقطعة زينة صغيرة، قررت بوجاتي دمجه في عدة أجزاء من المركبة. من الخارج تأتي شعارات EB الشهيرة، وغطاء خزان الوقود، وتطعيمات المحرك، بينما في الداخل يظهر في مقبض القير، وأغطية السماعات، ومساند الذراعين. والنتيجة؟ سيارة تجمع بين عالم الهندسة الميكانيكية والفن الحرفي بطريقة لم نشهدها من قبل.
هل هذه سيارة من فيلم رسوم متحركة؟ ربما. يتمثّل أحد أكثر التفاصيل إثارة في W16 Mistral Blanc Éternel في هيكلها الأبيض الناصع، الذي تحيط به خطوط سوداء مرسومة بعناية شديدة. تمنح هذه الخطوط مظهر فريد، وكأنها نموذج كرتوني مرسوم باليد ليكون “سيارة بطلة” في فيلم رسوم متحركة فاخر.. ولم يتوقف الجموح عند حدود التصميم الخارجي، إذ نقل المصممون الفكرة نفسها إلى المقصورة ليبدو هذا الطرح وكأنه عمل فني متكامل من الداخل والخارج..
تحمل هذه التوليفة قيمة عاطفية كبيرة أيضاً، لأنها واحدة من آخر السيارات التي تعتمد على المحرك التاريخي. نحن نتحدث عن قلب سعة 8.0 لتر، بـ 16 أسطوانة و4 شواحن توربو، كأحد أعظم المحركات في تاريخ الصناعة. نعم، تُعتبر W16 Mistral الفصل الأخير لهذه الحبكة الروائية الميكانيكية الأيقونية، قبل أن تسلم الراية إلى الجيل الجديد..
تجدر الإشارة إلى أن خليفة W16 وصل بالفعل عبر بوجاتي توربيون (Bugatti Tourbillon) الجديدة. وهي تعتمد على محرك V16 طبيعي التنفس بسعة 8.3 لتر، مع دعم من 3 محركات كهربائية، في إطار منظومة هجينة متطورة تمثل بداية عصر جديد للصانع الأوروبي. ومع انتقال بوجاتي إلى حقبة توربيون، تأتي W16 Mistral Blanc Éternel كتحية وداع أخيرة..
في نهاية المطاف.. عندما تمتلك سيارة تضم بورسلين حقيقي ومحرك W16 أسطوري بتصميم يبدو وكأنه لوحة فنية متحركة، فهناك وصف واحد فقط يناسبها:
“تحفة فرنسية لن تتكرر”.

title: A Porsche SUV with over 1000 Horsepower? The Cayenne Electric Zaps Its Way to Performance Supremacy
author: Austin Parsons
text:
2026 Porsche Cayenne Electric / Cayenne Coupe Electric
- Comfortable ride, impressive curved OLED touchscreen, plenty of interior space.
- Very expensive, no Active Ride for base models, soapy exterior styling.
- This new mid-size electric luxury SUV is every bit a Cayenne, just quieter and quicker.
For Sale Near You

Electric
All-Wheel Drive
4 Years/50,000 Miles
Overview
Following the compact Macan SUV's transition to electric power, the mid-size Cayenne SUV is the next step in Porsche's push to electrify its lineup. The Cayenne Electric is longer than its gas-sipping counterpart and features a lower roofline, giving it a squat and aggressive stance. It has the power figures to back up its look. The base Cayenne Electric produces a healthy 435 horsepower from its dual-motor, all-wheel-drive powertrain, while the S trim makes 657 horsepower. But the Turbo is the real stunner, with 1139 horsepower, an estimated 60 mph sprint of under 2.5 seconds, and active aerodynamics that improve range.
The Cayenne Electric features a large 108-kWh battery with a peak charge rate of 400 kW. It will be the first Porsche EV to feature a standard NACS charging port, which will allow the Cayenne Electric to charge on DC fast chargers. Overall, this electric SUV impresses with its combination of performance, luxury, technology, and driving satisfaction.
Expert Tip: Porsche also offers a fastback Cayenne Coupe Electric. If you can compromise slightly on interior space, the Coupe model offers slicker styling.

The Cayenne Electric and the Cayenne Coupe Electric are all-new models for the Porsche brand.

EV Motor, Power, and Performance
- EV Motors: 435-hp dual motor, 657-hp dual motor, 1139-hp dual motor
- Drivetrain: all-wheel drive
All Cayenne Electric models come with dual-motor powertrains and all-wheel drive. The base model produces 435 horsepower, and the S makes 657, but the Turbo is the star of the show with its massive 1139-hp output. That makes the Cayenne Electric the most powerful Porsche ever made by a comfortable margin.
Like the Taycan and Panamera, the Cayenne Electric is offered with Porsche's trick Active Ride suspension. The system's ability to soak up road imperfections and control body motions felt magical during our test drive of a Cayenne EV. Models not fitted with Active Ride have two-valve dampers and two-chamber air springs. Rear-axle steering can be optioned on both trims, and the Turbo also comes standard with a torque-vectoring limited-slip differential. The Turbo model features active aerodynamics in the form of aero blades that pop out of the rear of the car at speeds above 40 mph to reduce drag and improve range.
0–60-MPH Times
- Claimed 60-mph Time: 4.5 seconds (base), 3.6 seconds (S), 2.4 seconds (Turbo)
In Comparison: Porsche claims that the Cayenne Turbo Electric will blast to 60 mph in just 2.4 seconds, and we think it will be even quicker than that. It'll be far quicker than the gas-powered Cayenne Turbo GT despite being over 1000 pounds heavier.
Towing and Payload Capacity
- Max Towing: 7716 pounds
Porsche says that the Cayenne Electric will have a maximum towing capacity of 7716 pounds, which is mighty impressive for a luxury electric SUV. That's 2716 pounds more than the Cadillac Vistiq can pull, and equal to the Rivian R1S's maximum towing capacity.
Range, Charging, and Battery Life
- C/D Estimated EV Range: 330–340 miles (est)
Neither Porsche nor the EPA has released any official range estimates, but we expect its U.S. EPA range to be between 330 and 340 miles. As with all of Porsche's EVs, the Cayenne Electric will rely on an 800-volt electrical architecture.
The brand says that the Cayenne Electric will be its fastest-charging EV to date, with a peak charge rate of up to 400 kilowatts. It will also be the first of the company's EVs to feature a NACS charge port; a J1772 socket also comes on the opposite side of the vehicle. On a DC fast charger, Porsche claims that the Cayenne Electric can charge from 10 to 80 percent in just 16 minutes.
Interior, Comfort, and Cargo
First Row: The Cayenne Electric's cabin is, unsurprisingly, more tech-focused than the one in the gas-powered Cayenne. While the steering wheel and seating accommodations are largely similar, the Cayenne Electric's new infotainment screen design takes up a ton of interior real estate.
Second Row: The Cayenne Electric's wheelbase is almost five inches longer than the gas-powered Cayenne, which should grant it significantly more legroom for rear seat passengers. The second row can be folded down at the press of a button to increase cargo space.
Cargo Capacity: With the rear seat in the upright position, the squareback Cayenne Electric has 20 cubic feet of cargo space; that number jumps to 56 cubic feet with the second row folded down. There's also a little 3 cubic-foot frunk that's good for a backpack or two. The Cayenne Coupe Electric model is expected to offer a little less room in the trunk.
Infotainment and Connectivity
- Infotainment: 12.3-inch touchscreen, 14.9-inch passenger touchscreen (optional)
The Cayenne Electric's forward cabin is dominated by a new and unique 12.3-inch central infotainment touchscreen. The "Flow Display," as Porsche calls it, features a curved OLED screen that bends towards the driver and meets up with the center console in a single fluid unit. A 14.9-inch passenger display can also be optioned, which combines with the central touchscreen to occupy the majority of the dashboard.
Safety and Driver-Assistance Features
Porsche offers basic driver-assistance tech as standard in the Cayenne Electric. Some more advanced features, including a remote parking assistant, are available as options.
- Standard Safety Features: automated emergency braking, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist
- Optional Safety Features: remote parking feature, 360-degree exterior camera system
For information about the Cayenne Electric's crash-test results, visit the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) websites.
Warranty and Maintenance Coverage
Porsche provides a competitive warranty plan that's comparable to what other luxury EV marques offer. However, coverage of the Macan Electric's electrical components is capped at eight years or 100,000 miles, whereas Tesla offers unlimited mileage for the same amount of time.
- Limited Warranty: four years or 50,000 miles
- Powertrain Warranty: four years or 50,000 miles
- Battery Warranty: eight years or 100,000 miles
- Complimentary Maintenance: none

title: تجربة ROX ADAMAS في الإمارات: SUV صينية فاخرة تتحدى الرمال والجبال وتفاجئ الجميع
author: Top Gear Middle East; محمد مكحل
text:
لا، لم تعُد سيارات SUV الفاخرة القادمة من الشرق تكتفي بالاختبارات القصيرة للحكم على طراز يدّعي القدرة على الجمع بين الفخامة، التكنولوجيا، والقدرة على مواجهة أقسى الظروف. لهذا السبب، اصطحب فريق توب جير الشرق الأوسط ROX ADAMAS في تجربة قيادة ممتدة من دبي إلى الفجيرة، مروراً بالطرق السريعة، والجبال، والرمال، والصخور.. لنكتشف إن كانت هذه السيارة الصينية الفاخرة قادرة فعلاً على إثبات نفسها في بيئة الخليج القاسية.. وقد فعلت!
تعتمد ADAMAS فلسفة تصميم تسميها الشركة Gliding Luxury، أي الفخامة الانسيابية. وهي فلسفة تهدف إلى الجمع بين القوة والهدوء في شكل واحد. فمن الخارج، تبدو السيارة مختلفة عن معظم نظيراتها من فئة SUV الكهربائية الخارجة من خطوط الإنتاج العالمية مؤخراً. إذ يمنح الشبك الأمامي الماسي النمط حضور قوي، بينما تضيف مصابيح LED Matrix طابع تقني حديث، مع خطوط جانبية انسيابية تعطي إحساس بالحركة حتى عند التوقف.
على الطريق بين دبي وخورفكان، كان واضح أن السيارة مصممة لتبدو فاخرة في المدينة، لكنها لا تخجل من الاتساخ عندما تصل إلى الرمال. وفّر لنا ارتفاع الهيكل الكبير، والزوايا الجيدة للدخول والخروج، ثقة أكبر عند الدخول إلى المسارات الصخرية في جبال الفجيرة.
ماذا عن المقصورة؟ تنافس بقوة من حيث الجودة، بل وتضع نفسها في مصاف الأفضل ضمن فئتها عالمياً. داخل المقصورة، تحاول ROX ADAMAS أن تلعب في ملعب السيارات الأوروبية الفاخرة، وليس في فئة السيارات الصينية فقط. كسائق ستستفيد من مقاعد بجلد نابا، وسقف مبطن بميكروفايبر فاخر، وطبعاً إضاءة محيطية تعطي إحساس صالة فاخرة أكثر من وسيلة تنقل.
بدوره، يعمل النظام المعلوماتي عبر ROX OS مع معالج Qualcomm 8155، من أجل ضمان استجابة سريعة، مدعوم برسوميات جرافيك واضحة ومريحة للعين. والأهم أنه يدعم الأوامر الصوتية باللغة العربية، وهي نقطة مهمة “جداً” في سوق الشرق الأوسط. في الرحلة الطويلة من دبي إلى الفجيرة، كان مستوى الراحة ممتاز، خصوصاً مع نظام التعليق الهوائي الذي امتص المطبات والطرق غير المستوية بشكل مريح وسلس.. ولم نسمع أي شكوى من الفريق أجمع..
من ناحية الأداء، تعتمد هذه النسخة نظام REEV الهجين القابل للشحن، مع محركين كهربائيين وقوة إجمالية تصل إلى 476 حصان، مع 740 نيوتن متر من عزم الدوران. لتستطيع المركبة التسارع من الثبات صفر إلى 100 كم/س خلال 5.5 ثانية فقط. أوه نعم، ستتمكن من قيادتها كهربائياً فقط لمدى يصل إلى 235 كم، مع مدى إجمالي يصل إلى 1,226 كم.
في الطرق السريعة بين دبي والفجيرة، كانت هادئة جداً في الوضع الكهربائي، بينما يعمل محرك البنزين فقط عند الحاجة لزيادة المدى الكهربائي. الميزة هنا أنك تحصل على إحساس سيارة كهربائية، بدون قلق المدى.. إنه نظام REEV المثالي للشرق الأوسط.
على الرمال.. حلّت المفاجأة الحقيقية. عندما خرجنا من الطريق المعبد واتجهنا نحو الرمال، بدأ الاختبار الحقيقي. سمح لنا نظام التعليق الهوائي مع التحكم الديناميكي بالهيكل DCC برفع السيارة وتغيير قساوة التعليق، ومع وجود أوضاع قيادة متعددة مثل الرمل، الصخور، الطين، الجبال، والعبور المائي. لقد تمكّنت من التكيف مع التضاريس بشكل مفاجئ. وفي الكثبان الرملية قرب الفجيرة، حافظت على توازن ممتاز بفضل وزنها الكبير، دون أن نشعر بارتباكات الأوفرود الرملي الاعتيادية..
أما في المسارات الصخرية، فتألّقت بثبات غير متوقع. كان التحكم في العزم ممتاز بفضل نظام الدفع الكهربائي، حيث يمكن توزيع القوة بدقة على العجلات. من جهته، ساعد نظام التحكم في النزول من المرتفعات في الحفاظ على الثبات في المنحدرات، فيما امتص التعليق الهوائي الصدمات بدون أن نشعر في الداخل بالتعب. هذه النقطة بالذات كانت مفاجأة، لأن معظم السيارات الفاخرة لا تشعر بالراحة خارج الطريق المُعبّدة.
ومن أكثر الأمور التي لفتت انتباهنا في ROX ADAMAS هي أنها مصممة للرحلات فعلاً. إذ يجعل كل من نظام Tailgate Kitchen 2.0، والمظلة المدمجة في السقف، وإمكانية تشغيل الأجهزة عبر V2L بقدرة 3.5 كيلوواط، المركبة مناسبة للتخييم والتنقل الطويل (هذه الإضافات محدودة بحسب الإصدار). في توقفنا أثناء التصوير، استطعنا تشغيل أجهزة كهربائية بسهولة، وهو شيء لا نراه كثيراً في طروحات هذه الفئة.
الخلاصة: تجربة مختلفة تماماً. بعد تجربة ممتدة بين دبي والفجيرة، نستطيع القول إن ROX ADAMAS ليست مجرد سيارة فاخرة جديدة من الصين، بل محاولة جادة للانقلاب على الثقافة الميكانيكية العادية وتقديم مفهوم مُطوّر يجمع بين الفخامة، التكنولوجيا، القدرة على الطرق الوعرة، المدى الطويل، والراحة في التنقل.
ويُذكر أن ROX تعتزم إنشاء أول مصنع للسيارات مدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي في دولة الإمارات، على أن يتخذ من أبوظبي مقراً له.
لذا.. هل تنافس الأوروبيين؟
نعم.
هل تناسب الشرق الأوسط؟
أكثر مما تتوقع.
وهذا بالضبط ما أردنا اكتشافه في هذه التجربة النوعية.. والتي بإمكانك الاستمتاع بمشاهدتها كاملة في الفيديو المرفق..

title: 2026 Bentley Bentayga Review, Pricing, and Specs
author: Austin Parsons
text:
2026 Bentley Bentayga
- Ferocious twin-turbo V-8, designer-caliber interior materials, undeniable curb appeal.
- Prohibitive pricing, long-wheelbase upgrade is necessary for the full rear-seat experience, harsh ride betrays its otherwise sumptuous character.
- With a stop-and-stare visual presence and a designer interior, the Bentley Bentayga makes carpool pickups a special event.

Overview
If the Continental GT is a bit too quaint for your everyday needs, Bentley offers the Bentayga as a more substantial villa on wheels. From its bedazzled maw to its supple, leather-laden cabin, the Bentayga doesn't sacrifice any signature Bentley style in the name of a larger frame. Three powertrain options are available under its lengthy bonnet, ranging from a 456-hp plug-in hybrid to a 641-hp twin-turbo V-8 in the aptly named Bentayga Speed. Despite its sporty aspirations, the Bentayga places luxury at the forefront and is rivaled only by the Rolls-Royce Cullinan and Mercedes-Maybach GLS600 when it comes to big-body, five-seat opulence.
Where This Vehicle Ranks
#2 in Ultimate Luxury SUVsCompare the 2026 Bentley Bentayga with the top vehicles in this segment with our new compare tool.
What's New for 2026?
The Bentayga Speed returns with a vengeance after a two-year hiatus, now sporting a 641-hp twin-turbo V-8 and a host of other performance upgrades. A revised Sport drive mode enhances steering response and stiffens suspension damping by 15 percent for flatter cornering. Bentley also relaxes the stability control system, allowing for some seriously stylish drifts. All-wheel steering comes standard, making the Speed feel nimbler at low speeds and more stable at high speeds. Carbon ceramic brakes and a titanium Akrapovic exhaust are optional. The Speed also comes with exclusive exterior and interior design tweaks, including chrome Speed badging, tinted head and taillights, painted brake calipers, the choice of either 22-inch or 23-inch wheels, and embroidered Speed accenting.
If this year's model is largely unchanged and you're comfortable with a lightly used car, you may want to consider shopping previous model years. A one-to-three-year-old model will likely have a warranty and it'll cost less than buying new.
Pricing and Which One to Buy
Compare the 2026 Bentley Bentayga to other vehicles you're interested in
Our new comparison tool provides a comprehensive, side-by-side comparison of up to five vehicles of your choice.
Engine, Transmission, and Performance
Bentley offers several powertrains for the Bentayga. On the low end, you have a 456-hp hybrid arrangement with a turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 and an electric motor; Azure and S hybrids offer a slightly more powerful 456-hp version of the electrified powertrain, and a 542-hp twin-turbo V-8 engine is available in the S V-8. Regardless of what's under the hood, all Bentaygas utilize an eight-speed automatic transmission and come standard with all-wheel drive. With either powertrain, acceleration is fierce, and the Bentayga offers a placid ride. For the record, it can hustle down a curvy road better than its chief ultra-luxury SUV rival, the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, if that’s the motivating factor in deciding between the two. When we recently drove the new Bentayga Speed, we were impressed by its prodigious thrust but noted some turbo lag and ride harshness in Sport mode.
What's Your Car Worth?
Car and Driver calculates your car's value in three free and easy steps - using the same Black Book® data dealers use to appraise vehicles.
0–60-MPH Times
During testing, the Azure Hybrid reached 60 mph in 4.5 seconds—not bad, but not so as quickly as the big-power twin-turbo V-8. The V-8 launched the Bentayga S to 60 mph in just 3.5 seconds. We also tested a 2023 Bentley Bentayga S V-8 as part of our 0-to-150-to-0 speed test, where it hit 150 mph from rest and returned to a stop in just 32.8 seconds. We haven't had a chance to test the beastly Bentayga Speed yet, but Bentley says that it is their quickest ute to date, capable of delivering a 0-60 time of just 3.4 seconds. We'll update this section once we can either confirm or deny that claim in our testing.
Range, Charging, and Battery Life
With its 18-kWh battery pack fully charged, the EPA estimates that the Bentayga can drive up to 25 miles on electricity alone. When we tested a plug-in Bentayga in 2023, it outperformed that figure, achieving an average of 28 miles of range over seven charge cycles.
Fuel Economy and Real-World MPG
The EPA rates V-8-powered models at 14 mpg city and 21 mpg highway. The hybrid is expectedly more efficient, wearing a rating of 19 mpg city and 23 mpg highway. On our 75-mph highway fuel economy route, the V-8-powered Bentayga managed to outperform its EPA rating with a 24-mpg result. For more information about the Bentayga's fuel economy, visit the EPA's website.
Interior, Comfort, and Cargo
Filled with rich-smelling leather, real wood trim, and glitzy metal accents, the Bentayga's cabin stays true to its luxury breeding. Buyers can opt for front and rear buckets or select a three-across second-row bench. While the rear seat doesn't feel as lavish as that of the Rolls Cullinan’s it still has plenty of space for adult passengers to stretch out in. The long-wheelbase model offers more legroom and additional amenities, so that's the one to buy if you're planning on being chauffeured. It's still a two-row vehicle, and it can be ordered with 22-way-adjustable rear bucket seats that massage and recline up to 40 degrees. Two different mother-of-pearl-faced Breitling dash clocks are available as is a bottle cooler for rear-seat passengers, adjustable ambient interior lighting, and even a safe with a biometric lock and fingerprint reader. The Bentayga's cargo area is generous; we were able to fit nine carry-on suitcases back there. Bentley allows customers to customize just about everything inside through its Mulliner bespoke-build department—for a hefty price, of course.
Infotainment and Connectivity
All Bentayga models come standard with a 10.9-inch infotainment screen with navigation and Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. The optional entertainment system consists of two 10.2-inch displays mounted to the back of the front seat headrests. With it, rear-seat passengers can browse the web, interact with the Bentayga's infotainment system, or play movies. A 12-speaker stereo is standard, but you can opt for Naim's superb 20-speaker premium audio system.
Safety and Driver-Assistance Features
Bentley offers several driver-assistance features, but, surprisingly, almost all of them cost extra. Paradoxically, buyers of lesser luxury SUVs such as the BMW X7 or Cadillac Escalade will find that many of these features come standard. For more information about the Bentayga's crash test results, visit the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) websites. Key safety features include:
- Standard automated emergency braking with pedestrian detection
- Available lane-departure warning with lane-keeping assist
- Available adaptive cruise control and night-vision system
Warranty and Maintenance Coverage
Like all other Bentley models, the Bentayga comes standard with a three-year warranty that has no mileage expiration. Also, the first maintenance visit is free. The Cullinan offers more value here in the form of a four-year warranty package and four years of complimentary maintenance.
- Limited warranty covers three years, unlimited miles
- Powertrain warranty covers three years, unlimited miles
- Complimentary maintenance is covered for one year or 10,000 miles

title: كيا نيرو هايبرد 2027: تحديثات ذكية وشاشة ضخمة لكن بدون دفع رباعي
author: Top Gear Middle East; محمد مكحل
text:
على مدار 10 سنوات، نجحت كيا نيرو (Kia Niro) في حجز مكانة خاصة بين السيارات الهجينة الاقتصادية، بفضل استهلاكها المنخفض للوقود وسعرها المنافس. واليوم، تعود بصيغة هايبرد للعام 2027 بحزمة من التحديثات التقنية والتصميمية لتجعلها أكثر عصرية من أي وقت مضى.
لكن هناك سؤال ما زال يلاحقها: أين نظام الدفع الرباعي؟ لا عليك! اعتمدت كيا في نيرو 2027 لغة التصميم الحديثة Opposites United، مع إضافة توقيع الإضاءة الشهير Star Map، بعد أن رأيناه في أحدث طرازات الشركة الكورية.
قد تبدو التعديلات الخارجية بسيطة للوهلة الأولى، لكنها نجحت في منح السيارة حضور أكثر حداثة، وكأنها فئة جديدة بالكامل رغم احتفاظها بالمنصة نفسها المستخدمة في الجيل السابق. كما تؤكد كيا أنها أجرت تحسينات على نظام التعليق والشاسيه لزيادة راحة الركوب وخفض الضوضاء داخل المقصورة، مع الحفاظ على استجابة السيارة أثناء القيادة.
تحت الغطاء، تستمر كيا نيرو هايبرد 2027 باستخدام محركها المعروف، محرك بنزين رباعي الأسطوانات سعة 1.6 لتر، في إطار منظومة هجينة بقوة إجمالية تبلغ 139 حصان مع عزم دوران يصل إلى 264 نيوتن متر. يتم نقل القوة إلى العجلات عبر قير أوتوماتيكي مزدوج القابض من ست سرعات.
أما المفاجأة، فتتمثل في اختفاء نسختي Plug-in Hybrid والكهربائية بالكامل EV من التشكيلة، بعد إيقافهما خلال عام 2026. وتتوقع كيا أن تحافظ نظيرتهما الجديدة على مستويات استهلاك الوقود الممتازة التي اشتهرت بها، بعد أن وصلت سابقاً إلى نحو 85 كم لكل غالون في بعض الفئات..
يظهر أكبر تحديث داخل المقصورة من خلال الشاشة الجديدة. إذ ستحظى جميع الفئات قياسياً بشاشة معلومات وترفيه منحنية قياس 12.3 إنش. كما تأتي السيارة مع شاشة عدادات رقمية قياس 4 إنش بشكل قياسي، وشاشة عدادات رقمية 12.3 إنش اختيارية، مع مقود جديد بتصميم ثنائي اللون، وخامات داخلية تمنح المقصورة شعور أكثر فخامة.
نتفليكس ويوتيوب داخل السيارة! نعم، ما قرأته صحيح.. تدخل نيرو 2027 عصر السيارات المتصلة بالكامل بفضل نظام Connected Car Navigation Cockpit الجديد. وتشمل التجهيزات التقنية تحديثات برمجية عبر الهواء OTA، دعم Apple CarPlay وAndroid Auto لاسلكياً، تطبيقات بث مثل Netflix وYouTube وDisney+ في بعض الفئات، تخصيص واجهات العرض عبر متجر Kia Connect، ومساعد ذكي يعمل بالأوامر الصوتية عبر عبارة: “Hey, Kia”.
كما حصلت هذه النسخة على مجموعة موسعة من تقنيات السلامة، وتضم نظام الكبح التلقائي مع اكتشاف الدراجات والتقاطعات، نظام مراقبة النقاط العمياء، تنبيه حركة المرور الخلفية، مثبت سرعة ذكي مع مساعد البقاء في المسار، نظام القيادة على الطرق السريعة Highway Driving Assist 2، وكاميرا محيطية 360 درجة في الفئات الأعلى.
المشكلة القديمة.. نعم، ما زالت هنا! رغم كل هذه التحديثات، ما زالت نيرو تعاني من إحدى نقاط ضعفها الرئيسية، حيث لا تطوى المقاعد الخلفية بشكل مسطح تماماً، ما يحد من الاستفادة القصوى من مساحة التخزين. والأهم من ذلك، تستمر في تقديم نظام الدفع الأمامي فقط دون أي خيار للدفع الرباعي، وهو ما قد يدفع بعض العملاء إلى النظر نحو منافسين يقدمون قدرات أكبر في مختلف الظروف.
هل أصبحت نيرو أفضل؟ بكل تأكيد. فهي أكثر تطوراً من الناحية التقنية، أكثر أناقة من الخارج، وأكثر ذكاءً من الداخل. ومع ذلك، يبقى غياب الدفع الرباعي وبعض الحلول العملية سبب يمنع إصدار 2027 من الوصول إلى الكمال..
ومع اقتراب طرحها في الأسواق خلال الصيف، تبدو نيرو الجديدة مستعدة لمواصلة دورها كواحدة من أفضل سيارات الكروس أوفر الهجينة الاقتصادية.. مع بعض الأمنيات التي ما زالت بانتظار التحقق..

title: I Spent a Week With the BMW M2 CS and It Might Cure Depression
author: Sean Kealey
text:
BMW is a car company. That should be obvious by now, but I was not aware that BMW was in the pharmaceutical business. A week with the 2026 M2 CS revealed they have created a mechanical substitute for antidepressants. This is not medical advice, but this might actually cure depression. I didn’t feel anything close to that the week I spent driving this car around Southern California.
Production numbers and hype aside, this is a very special car, and I’m happy to talk about what it’s like to just commute with the car, run errands, and take it up to the canyon roads around Los Angeles.
A Special Engine For A Special Car
Let’s get the stats on this car out of the way. The M2 CS comes with a retuned S58, the twin-turbo inline-6 engine that has graced the M2, M3, and M4 of the G80 and G87 generation of M cars, but now it makes 523 hp and 479 lb-ft of torque. This is essentially M3 Competition power, now in a shorter and lighter chassis.
Motor Trend tested this exact car I drove at 3,699 lbs. This is over 100 lbs lighter than a “standard” G87. But an M2 equipped with a manual transmission and the $9,000 Carbon Pack comes in around 3,718 lbs when I last tested it a year ago, and that car was also making only 400 lb-ft of torque and about 50 less horsepower, with a much slower-shifting (but fun) manual gearbox.
2026 BMW M2 CS
Good
- More power (523 hp), less weight (3,699 lbs)
- Suspension feels sharper but still comfortable
- Carbon-ceramic brakes and serious street presence
Bad
- No cupholders, just a weak wireless charging pad
- Numb electric steering
- No manual transmission option
BMW’s M Division also made a number of chassis and performance improvements outside of the powertrain. The CS sits 8mm lower thanks to some new springs, and revised dampers provide a compliant and stiff ride that is somehow still comfortable enough for daily driving. The engine mounts are from the M4 CSL, and the transmission mounts are from the GT4 race car. The added NVH is noticeable but not terrible, just nice theater.
The front now has 2.1 degrees of negative camber instead of the standard M2’s 1.4. The rear remains at 1.5 degrees of negative camber, and both toe and caster remain unchanged. The car has undergone the Jenny Craig treatment for some fairly significant weight savings.
The wheels are BMW’s forged 826M finished in “Individual gold bronze,” and these wheels save approximately 3.7 lbs per corner for the front 19×9.5″ wheels and 5.6 lbs per corner for the rear 20×10.5″ wheels. Overall, that’s an 18.6-pound reduction in unsprung mass from the wheels alone. Add in the optional carbon-ceramic brakes (new as an option on the G87, as they were previously offered from the factory only on the M3 and M4 Competition) and you can shed another 28.6 lbs of unsprung mass. Overall, this is a 47.2-pound reduction. Remember, every pound of unsprung mass removed has the equivalent effect on acceleration and braking as removing 4-6 lbs out of the body of the car.
The weight savings continue with some bespoke parts for the M2 CS. Beyond the carbon-fiber roof, side mirrors, and bucket seats that save 44 lbs from the standard M2, this car comes equipped with one of the coolest carbon-fiber trunk lids in BMW’s history. This doesn’t just save another 7 lbs; it can actually provide approximately 50 lbs of downforce at around 150 mph. It also has exposed dry carbon fiber visible when you open the trunk, which you’ll probably frequently load up, as its 13.8 cu-ft of space gives this car plenty of practicality to run errands or take on road trips.
Lastly, the interior of the car features a bespoke center console for the CS and CSL models. The entire thing is made of carbon fiber, and it looks spectacular. The weight savings from it alone might not be significant, but it just looks cool. This does, however, lose the cupholders and center console storage bin in favor of a wireless charging pad (more on that later).
The Good, the Bad, and the Great
Here at BMWBLOG, we have already tested the new M2 CS on track. I was given the grueling task of driving it around for a week and seeing if the compromises to this “Competition Sport” model have made it unbearable to drive for anything outside of track days or Cars & Coffee events.
In short: No. This was awesome. But there are some caveats. Some things were surprisingly better about it than I expected, and some annoying things bothered me much more than I anticipated.
The Good: In the Feels
This M2 CS feels raw and alive. This car is exactly how a sports car should feel. Let me explain. The revised suspension is stiffer than the regular M2, but somehow, the revised damper tuning has allowed the car to actually feel more compliant without being harsh.
BMW seems to have listened to people complaining about F-chassis M cars and early G80s, because they have now made suspension tuning that feels confidence-inspiring without upsetting the handling of the car. You can certainly feel every bump. The car gives you the information about how rough the pavement is, but it seems to handle imperfections with one well-orchestrated movement of enough compression to absorb the impact, and just enough rebound to maintain the car’s contact patch without it feeling oversprung.
Whatever they did to the tuning, this team deserves a raise. This was pleasant enough for driving on city streets, but absolutely superhero-making on Angeles Crest Highway.
The raw feeling of this car doesn’t just stop at the suspension tuning. The car has less sound deadening for weight savings, and the steering has been revised for even more sharpness. It’s, unfortunately, as with all electrically-assisted steering, numb. But the precision and speed with which you can point the car in whatever direction you want is incredible.
F-22 pilots don’t complain that their stick lacks the hydraulic feel of an F-4. They simply learn to appreciate the insane capabilities the latest technology has given them to be the fastest, most dominant thing in the sky. Short of $180,000, that is what this car must feel like on a backroad.
The sensation this car gives you when you put all of these newly calibrated systems together is that of a raw sports car with just enough of the edge taken off to make it something you want to drive every day, and enough spice added back in to make you feel alive. There is no denying that you can feel the difference between this and the standard M2.
The Bad: You’ll Take My Cupholders From My Cold, Dead Hands
At first I thought it was just a strange choice to remove the cupholders from the car. Yes, I get this is a track-focused version of the M2, and you probably shouldn’t be putting any beverages in your $112,000 2 Series if you want to keep it in mint condition. However, I am a proud American, and I like to drink my drinks wherever and whenever I go. I found myself frequently walking up to the car and forgetting that I had nowhere to put them if it wasn’t a sealed water bottle, and either drove with one hand (not ideal) or chugged it before getting in.
What’s stranger isn’t just the annoyance of it, but also the reasoning. BMW claims this was to help with weight savings. But then they put in a wireless charging pad. That requires wiring and metal parts to work. Surely that can’t be any less weight than cupholders?
Also, wireless charging pads are one of my mortal enemies in the car design world. Automakers, including BMW, don’t do a great job integrating them into cars. As is the case here, they often let the phone sitting on it slide around too easily, and they take up a bunch of space that could have just been storage. But worst of all, they don’t even really work. Most are only 8W chargers, which might, at best, barely help it maintain a charge if it doesn’t slide off while driving. At worst, it turns into a phone heater.
There are already USB-C plugs for charging your phones. BMW: please take out wireless charging pads unless you integrate MagSafe charging with some cooling built in. (Luckily, that is coming on the Neue Klasse cars.)
Thank you for listening to my rant about a complete waste of interior space that replaced something I would actually use (cupholders) with something that doesn’t work, isn’t lighter, and is, in fact, very annoying. I will die on this hill. The good news? This is the worst thing about the car.
The Great: BMW Aura Defined
You may have already noticed the Blue Velvet paint and the Gold 826M Forged wheels. You might have noticed the carbon bucket seats and a sea of carbon fiber and Alcantara on the interior. You might have noticed that lip spoiler, subtle red on the M2 CS logo, and new grille up front. There is no doubt about it. This car is DRIPPING in cool.
I thought the M5 Touring drew a crowd everywhere I drove, but this was even more popular. People LOVED this car. Anyone who was a car enthusiast knew what it was and wanted to take a picture of it or ask about it. However, it’s not just the looks of the car; it’s the driving experience that backs it up.
This car was totally fine on my daily commutes on the freeways around Los Angeles. But out in some of the mountain roads around the city, this car comes to life. Once you start to push the car a little bit, all of the small changes they’ve made become apparent. Everything feels cohesive. Everything talks to you. The car is a bit of a handful if you’re not careful, but it also keeps taunting you to give it more.
The increased camber and optional Michelin Cup 2R tires give this car an extreme amount of grip and confidence on turn-in. The more aggressive M differential is more than happy to send power to the outside rear wheel and aid in rotation on corner exit. These two little changes make an already fun car into something that is more than happy to turn and change direction.
The brakes aren’t just good. They are violent in how quickly they can bring a 3,699-lb car down to the right speed before turn-in on a corner. They don’t bite too aggressively at first, either; they’ve done a great job getting the carbon-ceramic brakes to modulate progressively, with the right amount of braking input corresponding to the right amount of braking force throughout the pedal travel. If you’ve been to a few driving schools or have some track time, this is a car that rewards good driving technique without pushing newer drivers too much. This car is just a riot to drive on a backroad.
Did BMW Leave Room for an M2 CSL or M2 CS Handschalter?
After spending a week with the car and looking it over, I found that there were a few ways BMW’s M Division could have made the car lighter and even more focused. While 3,699 lbs is great given the car’s power and capability, I couldn’t help but notice how easily they could have shed a lot more weight.
The first easy area to reduce the weight of the car would be the battery. The battery located under the trunk is the standard AGM battery found in every BMW from the M340i to the M2 and M3/M4. Simply switching over to a lithium-ion battery (like I did in my own personal M340i with this exact battery) can reduce weight by 48 lbs or more.
Then there is the exhaust. BMW offers a very cool-looking titanium exhaust that would shave another 18 lbs out of the car, but you would need to order it separately from the dealership and have it installed after taking delivery of your M2 CS.
Lastly, there is the transmission. The ZF 8-speed is, as always, phenomenal. But if you want to make a lightweight, driver-focused car, the 6-speed manual gives you all the joy of rowing your own gears while losing 49 lbs from the automatic. That seems like a win-win as far as what the true mission of this car is, unless you are chasing lap times.
I recently attended the unveiling of the M3 CS Handschalter. The limited-edition M3 CS with a manual transmission was met with huge fanfare and excitement that the brand is keeping enthusiast-based manual transmission cars alive. It’s less powerful than the M3 CS, and no one cared. The fact is, rare performance-focused manual transmission cars have a special place in the enthusiast community. Every time Porsche makes a manual GT3 or limited-edition car, it sells for crazy money.
If BMW wants to take a page from their book and repeat the success of the M3 CS Handschalter, I sincerely hope they will make an M2 CS Handschalter or an M2 CSL. They could also take a page from the Porsche 911 992.2 GT3 playbook and shorten the gearing to compensate for the less power and torque required to deal with the torque constraints of BMW’s current manual S6S-420G gearbox. While the Porsche’s gearing was shortened to compensate for the power loss from meeting stricter EU emissions regulations with OPF filters, the same approach could help offset the power loss from detuning the S58 for the 6-speed manual instead of the ZF 8-speed.
Also, shorter gears mean more shifting. More shifting in a manual is more fun. BMW: feel free to steal my ideas as long as I get to drive the car.
Carrying the Ultimate Driving Machine Flame
I was sad the day they came to pick up the M2 CS. I had such a great time with the car, and it just brought me back to the driving experience of the E46 M3 my dad had when I was a kid. It feels so special. Compared to the already great M2, this is sharper, meaner, more visceral, and sexier. The driving experience exceeds the sum of all of the upgraded parts they’ve added to it.
This car is truly fun and exciting to drive, but it’s just comfortable enough and practical enough that you’ll want to drive it every day. Sure, you could keep it in a garage, and it will hold its value or even gain value over time, but don’t. This is a car that is meant to be driven, and I hope its owners get out and share the gospel of M with other car enthusiasts at Cars & Coffee events.
This car is a manual transmission and two cupholders away from becoming one of the greatest M cars of the last decade. The added price tag is absolutely worth it. If you are one of the 1,000 or so owners of one of these cars coming to the US: consider yourself blessed.

title: ماكمورتري سبيرلينغ بيور تصل بسعر 1.3 مليون دولار.. هايبركار كهربائية تقود رأساً على عقب
author: Top Gear Middle East; محمد مكحل
text:
عند الحديث عن الهايبركارز، سنجد أن هناك سيارات سريعة، وأخرى سريعة جداً. ثم تأتي فئة خاصة تقف وحدها في زاوية أخرى من الكون، حيث تُكتب قوانين جديدة للأداء وتُعاد صياغة مفهوم السرعة بالكامل. أهلاً بك في عالم ماكمورتري سبيرلينغ بيور (McMurtry Spéirling Pure)، واحدة من أكثر السيارات جنوناً وإثارةً خلال السنوات الأخيرة.
إنها سيارة كهربائية مخصصة للحلبات فقط، بقوة تقارب من 1,000 حصان، وقدرة ضغط سفلي تتجاوز 4,400 رطل (نحو 2,000 كجم) حتى عندما تكون سرعتها صفر! نعم، يمكنها توليد قوة شفط هائلة وهي متوقفة في مكانها، وكأنها خرجت مباشرة من خلف النجوم في فيلم ستار وورز.
من نموذج تجريبي إلى تحفة إنتاجية.. أمضت ماكمورتري الأعوام الماضية وهي تحطم الأرقام القياسية على أشهر الحلبات العالمية بواسطة نموذجها الأولي، تاركةً الخبراء والجماهير في حالة من الذهول. واليوم، تكشف الشركة البريطانية عن النسخة الإنتاجية النهائية تحت اسم Spéirling Pure.
ورغم التشابه الكبير مع النموذج التجريبي، تؤكد الشركة أن السيارة الجديدة تتضمن 95% من المكونات الجديدة كلياً. لتشمل التحديثات بطارية أكبر وأكثر كفاءة، تحسين نظام التبريد، تطوير المحركات الكهربائية، تعديلات على التصميم الخارجي، هيكل أحادي من ألياف الكربون يستوفي معايير رياضة المحركات العالمية، ومساحة أكبر للسائق على مستوى الأرجل والكتفين.
كما انتقلت البطارية من سعة 60 كيلوواط/ساعة إلى 100 كيلوواط/ساعة، ما يمنح قدرة أكبر على خوض جلسات القيادة المكثفة على الحلبات. وتقول الشركة إن السيارة تستطيع قطع مسافة تتراوح بين 25 و31 ميل (40 و50 كم) على وتيرة سباقات LMP2 قبل الحاجة إلى إعادة الشحن. أما عملية الشحن فتستغرق بين 20 و60 دقيقة وفقاً لدرجة الحرارة الخارجية وقدرة الشاحن المستخدم.
تعتمد سبيرلينغ بيور على محركين كهربائيين ينقلان القوة إلى العجلات الخلفية فقط. تبلغ القوة الإجمالية 986 حصان، بتسارع يُحرج سيارات الفورمولا 1 نحو 100 كم/س خلال 1.55 ثانية فقط.. وهذا يا صديقي.. رقم كفيل بجعل معظم الطرازات الخارقة تبدو وكأنها تتحرك بالتصوير البطيء..
السر الكبير؟ نظام المراوح السحري! إذا سبق لك مشاهدة فيديوهات ماكمورتري، فأنت تعلم أن هذه السيارة تستطيع القيام بحيلة تبدو مستحيلة: القيادة وهي مقلوبة رأساً على عقب. يكمن السر في نظام Downforce-on-Demand، الذي يعتمد على مروحتين ضخمتين أسفل الهيكل تعملان مع نظام عتبات هوائية خاصة لتوليد أكثر من 4,400 رطل من الضغط السفلي حتى عندما تكون السرعة صفر، كما أشرنا سابقاً.
ولزيادة الاعتمادية، جُهزت السيارة بمروحتين بدلاً من واحدة، لتستطيع إحداهما مواصلة إنتاج كمية هائلة من الضغط السفلي في حال تعرض الأخرى لأي خلل. أما النتيجة على الحلبة، فهي أرقام يصعب استيعابها.. نحن نتحدث عن تسارع جانبي يصل إلى 3G أثناء المنعطفات، بالتزامن مع قوة كبح تصل إلى 3G أيضاً، ومستويات تماسك لم يختبرها سوى عدد محدود جداً من السائقين حول العالم. باختصار.. هذه السيارة لا تنعطف حول المنعطفات، وإنما تلتهمها التهاماً..
تخطط العلامة لإنتاج 100 نسخة فقط من صيغتها الإنتاجية، مع سعر ابتدائي يبلغ 1.3 مليون دولار. ويستطيع العملاء طلب دعم فني ومصنعي كامل للمشاركة في الفعاليات والبطولات المختلفة. إذ ستكون السيارة مؤهلة للمشاركة في GT1 Sports Club، Global Time Attack، وTime Attack Masters الأوروبية.
أين يمكن مشاهدة هذه التحفة؟ ستظهر أمام الجمهور خلال مهرجان جودوود للسرعة (Goodwood Festival of Speed)، قبل وصولها إلى الولايات المتحدة ضمن فعاليات أسبوع مونتيري للسيارات (Monterey Car Week).
الخلاصة؟ نحن أمام بيان تصبح فيه الفيزياء اقتراح قابل للتفاوض! ماكمورتري سبيرلينغ بيور ليست مركبة كهربائية فائقة الأداء فحسب، وإنما مشروع هندسي يعيد تعريف مفهوم التماسك والتسارع والضغط السفلي.
والأجمل من كل شيء؟ أن التقنيات التي تحملها قد تمهد الطريق مستقبلاً لظهور إصدارات أكثر عملية وأقل تكلفة تتبنى الفلسفة الهندسية نفسها. وحتى ذلك الحين، ستبقى واحدة من أكثر الطروحات إدهاشاً وجرأةً في تاريخ الميكانيكا الحديثة يا رجل..

title: BMW Just Finished Its $1.7 Billion Bet on South Carolina
author: Horatiu Boeriu
text:
BMW Group has completed a $1.7 billion investment in its South Carolina operations, finishing the expansion of Plant Spartanburg and the construction of an entirely new plant in Woodruff. The company marked the milestone with a “Home of X” event at Spartanburg that doubled as the world premiere of the fifth-generation BMW X5.
Two Plants, One Network
BMW first announced the South Carolina investment plan back in 2022, and Milan Nedeljković, Chairman of the Board of Management at BMW AG, used the Home of X event to close the loop on that promise. “Today, we are delivering on that commitment,” he said. “The completion of our investments in Plant Spartanburg and Plant Woodruff demonstrates our confidence in the United States and reinforces South Carolina’s role at the center of BMW Group’s global operations.”
Plant Spartanburg and Plant Woodruff now function as a single integrated production network rather than two separate facilities. Spartanburg remains the global center of competence for BMW X models, a title it has held since the plant opened in 1994. Woodruff is new, and its job is electrification, specifically supporting the assembly of fully electric X models alongside Spartanburg’s existing lines.
The Numbers Behind Spartanburg
Spartanburg is BMW’s largest plant worldwide, and the figures back that up. More than 7.3 million vehicles have rolled off the line since 1994. In 2025 alone, the plant built 412,799 X models, the seventh time it has cleared 400,000 units in a single year. Roughly half of everything built there gets exported, shipped to nearly 120 countries, which is a big part of why BMW is the leading automotive exporter in the United States by value. Nearly 3 million BMWs have left the country from South Carolina, worth more than $113 billion.
Zoom out further and the US footprint gets bigger still: nearly 30 BMW locations across 12 states, more than 400 suppliers, and a claimed 120,000-plus jobs supported nationwide, contributing more than $43.3 billion a year to the economy. BMW has now been building cars in South Carolina for over three decades, and “Home of X” is the company’s way of framing the US not as an export market it happens to manufacture in, but as the actual home base for its X lineup.
The iX5 Leads The Electric Push
The headline production news is the iX5. BMW confirmed it will be the first fully electric BMW assembled in the United States, with production starting in late 2026. That timeline lines up with the new, fifth-generation X5 that premiered at the same event, which BMW says will be available with five different drivetrain options, including the electric iX5. Spartanburg will be the first plant anywhere in BMW’s global network capable of building a single model across five drivetrain technologies on one assembly line, which is a genuinely uncommon flex for a plant this size and is more a statement about manufacturing flexibility than about any one powertrain winning out.
The X5 itself has sold more than 3 million units globally since it launched in 1999 and effectively created the premium SUV segment as we know it. About a third of those sales came from the US, so building the next generation, electric variant included, in South Carolina is as much about proximity to BMW’s biggest X5 market as it is a broader electrification statement.

title: The 6 Most Interesting Things About the New BMW X5
author: Horatiu Boeriu
text:
Article Summary
- The G65 X5 replaces its door handles entirely with B-pillar-mounted Winglets that open three different ways, including a full mechanical fallback.
- The double-X headlight graphic pays homage to the original 1999 E53 and can be switched off from the iDrive menu.
- BMW's first genuine slate trim and passenger touchscreen debut on the X5, alongside a five-powertrain lineup that includes a 2028 hydrogen variant.
BMW just replaced the X5’s door handles with pillar-mounted sensors, borrowed a party trick from the 7 Series, and put real stone on the center console. The fifth-generation X5, codenamed G65, revealed itself as the biggest break from the outgoing model in the nameplate’s 27-year history, and these are the five details worth knowing before it hits dealers.
1. BMW Winglets: Three Ways to Open the Door
The G65 does away with the conventional mid-door handle entirely. In its place is the BMW Winglet, a slim gloss-black tab mounted into the B- and C-pillars rather than the door skin itself, a look BMW previewed on the limited-run Skytop and Speedtop before bringing it to a regular-production model for the first time. It’s standard equipment on every X5, not an option, and it comes paired with a standard soft-close mechanism regardless of trim.
There are three ways to work the Winglet from outside the car. A light touch on the sensor at the front edge triggers the powered release on cars with the optional automatic doors. If the power system is off or the buyer skipped that option, a gentle pull engages the integrated servo motor that lets the door swing with minimal effort. And if none of that is available, a firm pull operates the winglet like a conventional handle, since BMW built a fully mechanical fallback into the design so nobody gets locked out by a dead sensor. Locking works the same way in reverse: hold a finger on the front locking surface for about a second and the car locks itself.
2. X Headlights Pay Homage to the Original X5
The new double-X light graphic is the most talked-about piece of the exterior redesign, and it’s not just a styling flourish. BMW is calling it a nod to the Home of X in Spartanburg and to the E53, the 1999 original that invented the sporting SUV category and put BMW’s X lineup on the map. The graphic folds the low beams, daytime running lights, side lights, and turn signals into a single housing, which BMW says is a first for the brand, and it stays lit day and night as part of the welcome light sequence.
Not everyone is going to want an X tattooed across their front bumper permanently, and BMW built in an escape hatch. Buyers who’d rather not run the double-X motif can switch it off inside the iDrive menu, which reverts the housing to a simpler diagonal light bar. Cornering lights remain standard either way.
3. Open and Close the Doors With the Brake Pedal
Buyers who option the automatic doors get a feature already familiar to 7 Series owners: once you’re seated with your foot on the brake, pressing the pedal automatically closes all four doors. No reaching for a handle, no button hunt. BMW carried the same radar-based sensor setup from the 7 Series into the X5’s front and rear side skirts, and the company says it’s quicker to react and better at spotting nearby obstacles than the systems it replaces. Spy photos of the next-generation X7 (G67), due in 2027, already show it wearing the same winglet hardware, so the brake-pedal trick is a reasonable bet to show up there too.
Skip the automatic-door option entirely and you don’t lose much. Soft Close, which pulls each door the rest of the way shut once it’s nearly latched, comes standard across the whole X5 lineup at no extra cost.
4. Genuine Slate BMW: A First for the Brand
BMW is putting real stone inside a production car for the first time. It’s available as part of the optional BMW Glass Controls package, which bonds an ultra-thin layer of authentic slate to a contoured base rather than trying to fake the texture in plastic. It looks the part and it feels the part too, with the same small bumps and irregular grain you’d expect from actual stone rather than a smooth composite standing in for one.
The slate covers the center console control panel, giving the cockpit a matte, tactile surface that sits in deliberate contrast to all the glass and screens surrounding it. BMW built touch-sensitive controls for the parking brake, hazard lights, and rear defrost directly into the stone itself, and the package pairs the slate with crystal glass on the gear selector, the volume roller, and the seat-adjustment switches. It’s a genuinely unusual materials choice for an interior at this price point.
5. The First Passenger Screen in a BMW SUV
The cabin also debuts BMW’s first passenger touchscreen on an SUV, a 14.6-inch, full-HD optional display that runs independently of the main central 17.9 display. It’s not a brand first outright, since the facelifted 7 Series got there before it but it’s optional in the new X5.
The screen handles video streaming, live TV, music, and gaming through BMW’s AirConsole integration, which turns a passenger’s phone into a game controller, and it also doubles as a video-conferencing display using the cabin’s interior camera. BMW built in a safeguard for the obvious concern: while the X5 is moving, that same interior camera watches for driver distraction, and a shield function automatically darkens the passenger display if it catches the driver looking over.
6. The First BMW With Five Powertrains
No BMW has ever launched with this many ways to power it. The G65 covers mild-hybrid gas engines, a diesel that won’t come to the US, plug-in and mild-hybrid electrification, a fully electric iX5, and a hydrogen fuel-cell version BMW says it’s targeting for 2028 production. Offering gas, diesel, PHEV, MHEV, battery-electric, and hydrogen under one nameplate is BMW hedging every bet on where propulsion regulation and buyer demand actually land over the next few years, rather than picking a lane and committing to it.

title: The 2027 Bentley Bentayga Turns Every Commute into a First-Class Flight
author: Drew Dorian
text:
2027 Bentley Bentayga
- Potent hybrid and gas-only powertrains, couture interior, built-in baller status.
- Firm ride for an otherwise plush vehicle, priced for those benefiting from the K-shaped economy.
- The Bentayga is an SUV with performance, prestige, and prodigality.
For Sale Near You
See all results for new 2027 Bentley Bentayga for sale near 10022
Overview
The 2027 Bentayga marries Bentley's characteristic blend of luxury and performance with an SUV form factor that's vastly more practical than the Continental GT coupe. You can have your Bentayga as a plug-in hybrid with around 20 miles of EV driving range, but the real fun starts when you equip the optional 542-hp twin-turbo V-8 engine; the performance-oriented Speed model bumps the V-8's output to 641 horses.
The exterior is fashionable and appropriately flashy, adding a touch of celebrity to even the most mundane commute. The cabin is where the real luxury lives, with premium materials such as leather, wood, and polished metal lining every square inch. The extended-wheelbase models offer the most relaxing interiors, with extra legroom in the back and—for a truly fancy experience—optional reclining rear seats.
Expert Tip: If the Bentayga isn't exclusive enough for you, consider the more expensive—albeit less sporting—Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
What's New for 2027?
A new Artenara Edition joins the Bentayga lineup this year. The special model wears a more monochromatic wardrobe, with a darkened double-diamond mesh grille and body-color lower trim pieces. These new editions roll on 22-inch gray wheels and feature an animated Artenara Edition-specific welcome lamp projection. The interior features a tri-color upholstery motif, illuminated treadplates, and special trim. Otherwise, a new 23-inch wheel design joins the option list and is available on Azure, Artenara, and Mulliner models.
What's Your Car Worth?
Car and Driver calculates your car's value in three free and easy steps - using the same Black Book® data dealers use to appraise vehicles.
Pricing and Which One to Buy
Engine, Transmission, and Performance
- Engines: turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 and one electric motor, 456 hp combined; 542-hp twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8; 641-hp twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8
- Transmission: 8-speed automatic
- Drivetrain: all-wheel drive
Bentley offers several powertrains for the Bentayga. On the low end, you have a 456-hp plug-in-hybrid arrangement with a turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 and an electric motor; a 542-hp twin-turbo V-8 engine nonhybrid is optional. The real performer is the Speed model, which packs a 641-hp version of the twin-turbo V-8. Regardless of what's under the hood, all Bentaygas utilize an eight-speed automatic transmission and come standard with all-wheel drive.
With either powertrain, acceleration is fierce, and the Bentayga offers a placid ride. For the record, it can hustle down a curvy road better than its chief ultra-luxury SUV rival, the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, if that’s the motivating factor in deciding between the two. When we recently drove the new Bentayga Speed, we were impressed by its prodigious thrust but noted some turbo lag and ride harshness in Sport mode.
0–60-MPH Times
- C/D 60-mph Test: 4.5 seconds (Azure Hybrid), 3.5 seconds (S V-8)
In Comparison: The V-12-powered Rolls-Royce Cullinan managed the same 4.5-second 60 mph result as the Bentayga Hybrid. At 3.5 seconds to 60 mph, the Bentayga S V-8 is far quicker than the Rolls.
Towing and Payload Capacity
- Max Towing: 7700 pounds
Properly equipped, the Bentayga is rated to tow up to 7700 pounds, which should be more than enough for a boat or horse trailer.
Range, Charging, and Battery Life
- EPA EV Range: 20 miles
With its 18-kWh battery pack fully charged, the EPA estimates that the Bentayga can drive up to 20 miles on electricity alone. When we tested a plug-in Bentayga in 2023, it outperformed that figure, achieving an average of 28 miles of range over seven charge cycles.
Fuel Economy and Real-World MPG
- C/D 75-mph Highway Fuel-Economy Test: 24 mpg (S V-8)
- EPA City Ratings: 14-19 mpg
- EPA Highway Ratings: 21-23 mpg
The EPA rates V-8-powered models at 14 mpg city and 21 mpg highway. The hybrid is expectedly more efficient, wearing a rating of 19 mpg city and 23 mpg highway. On our 75-mph highway fuel economy route, the V-8-powered Bentayga managed to outperform its EPA rating with a 24-mpg result. For more information about the Bentayga's fuel economy, visit the EPA's website.
Interior, Comfort, and Cargo
First Row: Filled with rich-smelling leather, real wood trim, and glitzy metal accents, the Bentayga's cabin stays true to its luxury breeding. Two different mother-of-pearl-faced Breitling dash clocks are available, as is a bottle cooler for rear-seat passengers, adjustable ambient interior lighting, and even a safe with a biometric lock and fingerprint reader. Bentley allows customers to customize just about everything inside through its Mulliner bespoke-build department—for a hefty price, of course.
Second Row: Buyers can opt for rear bucket seats or select a three-across second-row bench. While the rear seat doesn't feel as lavish as that of the Rolls Cullinan, it still has plenty of space for adult passengers to stretch out in. The long-wheelbase model offers more legroom and additional amenities, so that's the one to buy if you're planning on being chauffeured. It can be ordered with 22-way-adjustable rear bucket seats that massage and recline up to 40 degrees.
Cargo Capacity: The Bentayga's cargo area is generous; we were able to fit nine carry-on suitcases back there.
Infotainment and Connectivity
- Infotainment: 10.9-inch touchscreen (standard); dual 10.2-inch rear passenger displays (optional)
- Connectivity: Bluetooth, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Audio System: 12-speaker stereo (standard), 16-speaker Bang & Olufsen stereo (optional), 20-speaker Naim stereo (optional)
All Bentayga models come standard with a 10.9-inch infotainment screen with navigation and Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. The optional rear seat entertainment system consists of two 10.2-inch displays mounted to the back of the front seat headrests. With it, rear-seat passengers can browse the web, interact with the Bentayga's infotainment system, or play movies. A 12-speaker stereo is standard, but you can opt for a 16-speaker Bang & Olufsen setup or Naim's superb 20-speaker premium audio system.
Safety and Driver-Assistance Features
Bentley offers several driver-assistance features, but, surprisingly, almost all of them cost extra. Paradoxically, buyers of lesser luxury SUVs such as the BMW X7 or Cadillac Escalade will find that many of these features come standard.
- Standard Safety Features: automated emergency braking, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring.
- Optional Safety Features: night vision, lane-keeping assist, adaptive cruise control
For information about the Bentayga's crash-test results, visit the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) websites.
Warranty and Maintenance Coverage
Like all other Bentley models, the Bentayga comes standard with a three-year warranty that has no mileage expiration. Also, the first maintenance visit is free. The Cullinan offers more value here in the form of a four-year warranty package and four years of complimentary maintenance.
- Limited Warranty: three years, unlimited miles
- Powertrain Warranty: three years, unlimited miles
- Complimentary Maintenance: one year or 10,000 miles

title: How Expensive Can A 2027 BMW X5 Get? We Found Out
author: Adrian Padeanu
text:
Article Summary
- Our build tops €130,000 and includes nearly every available option.
- We did skip the extended service plan, accessories, and an extra set of wheels, all of which would have pushed the price even higher.
- This configuration is based on the X5 40 xDrive, with even pricier versions arriving later this year.
Even in base form, the new X5 already verges on six figures in Germany. But how expensive can it get with every option ticked? We decided to find out by spending our virtual money on a fully loaded G65. You’ll need at least €95,750 to get behind the wheel of the luxury SUV in 40d xDrive diesel guise. However, our build is based on the gasoline-powered 40 xDrive because it has a higher starting price of €99,750.
Ticking just a single box on the options list pushes the price past €100,000. For example, the Dravit Grey paint we chose is a BMW Individual finish that costs an extra €2,140. Fancy those two-tone 23-inch alloys? Codenamed 1121 M, the new aerodynamic wheels will set you back another €1,400. An even pricier option is available inside, where the BMW Individual Vintage Coffee leather upholstery commands a hefty €5,450 premium.
At launch, the only optional package available for the 2027 BMW X5 in its home market is the €1,940 Seat Comfort Package. Both the driver and front passenger get electrically adjustable, ventilated, and massaging seats. Then come the individual options, which are predictably plentiful on the fifth-generation model. There’s everything from a €1,550 Bowers & Wilkins sound system to a €1,450 passenger screen.
The extra display on the passenger side of the dashboard isn’t the X5’s only new feature. For an additional €1,250, buyers can opt for automatic doors complete with a soft-close function. Our virtual build also includes the €500 tinted rear windows, which, at this price point, arguably should’ve been standard. Rear passengers can also benefit from optional sunshades for €330, while four-zone climate control adds another €800 to the bill.
One of the most important upgrades is the €3,650 Adaptive Chassis Control, which combines air suspension on both axles with rear-wheel steering. Other goodies include the Ceremonial Light Carpet (€350), a towbar (€1,200), and heated rear seats (€750). Selecting the latter also adds heated armrests to all four doors, as well as the front and rear center armrests.
(Almost) Everything Included
It all adds up to a princely sum of just over €132,000. However, there are still more ways to spend money on a new X5. Add accessories such as bicycle racks and roof boxes, a winter wheel-and-tire set, and an extended servicing plan, and the total climbs past €141,000. Once the X5 M60e and the iX5 60 xDrive join the configurator on October 8, those versions will push the price beyond €150,000 with every option included.
BMW will expand the X5 lineup next year with a V8-powered M Performance model, and that one is likely to cost even more. If reports are accurate, the X5 M will return in 2028 with an eight-cylinder engine, alongside an electric counterpart. Whether it breaks the €200,000 barrier with every option remains to be seen, but we wouldn’t be surprised if it does.

title: تويوتا ترد على صعود السيارات الصينية: الجودة والاعتمادية سر الحفاظ على الصدارة
author: Top Gear Middle East; محمد مكحل
text:
هناك قاعدة قديمة تقول: السرعة تلفت الأنظار، أما الاعتمادية فتكسب القلوب. ويبدو أن تويوتا (Toyota) تؤمن بهذه القاعدة أكثر من أي وقت مضى، خاصة مع الصعود المذهل لشركات السيارات الصينية خلال السنوات الأخيرة.
فبعد بيع أكثر من 10.5 مليون سيارة خلال عام 2025 تحت علامتي تويوتا ولكزس، احتفظت الشركة اليابانية بلقب أكبر مصنع سيارات في العالم للعام السادس على التوالي. وعند احتساب مبيعات دايهاتسو أيضاً، يرتفع الرقم إلى نحو 11.2 مليون سيارة. ما يمنحها فارق مريح أمام مجموعة فولكس واجن بعد أن سجلت قرابة 8.7 مليون سيارة فقط.. تماماً كفريق مانشستر سيتي في البريميرليج بما يحققه من فارق كبير في رصيد نقاط الترتيب العام..
لا يأتي التهديد الحقيقي هذه المرة من أوروبا أو الولايات المتحدة، وإنما من الصين. أنهت BYD عام 2025 في المركز السادس عالمياً بعد تسليم 4.6 مليون سيارة، مع نمو مستمر وطموحات كبيرة للوصول إلى المركز الأول عالمياً خلال السنوات الخمس المقبلة.
أما مجموعة SAIC، المالكة لعلامة MG، فاحتلت المركز السابع بمبيعات بلغت 4.5 مليون سيارة، في حين سجّلت جيلي (Geely) نمو ضخم بنسبة 26% لتصل إلى 4.12 مليون سيارة وتدخل قائمة أكبر عشرة مصنّعين في العالم. أرقام كهذه كفيلة بإثارة قلق أي شركة عريقة.. إلا أن تويوتا تبدو هادئة للغاية..
ما الذي يمنحها هذه الثقة؟ وفقاً لـ جون باباس، نائب رئيس المبيعات والتسويق والامتيازات في تويوتا أستراليا، فإن سر قوة الشركة يتمثل في ثلاثة عناصر أساسية: QDR. وتعني Quality / الجودة، وDurability / المتانة، وReliability / الاعتمادية.
ويؤكد باباس أن العملاء يتجهون دائماً نحو علامات تجارية يثقون بها في أوقات عدم اليقين، وأن سمعة تويوتا بُنيت على مدار عقود من تقديم إصدارات معروفة بتحملها وقيمتها العالية. وترى العلامة أن تفوقها لا يعتمد على المنتج وحده، فهناك عوامل أخرى تعزز مكانتها، من بينها شبكة وكلاء ضخمة حول العالم، وخدمات ما بعد البيع، وتوافر قطع الغيار، إلى جانب القيمة المرتفعة عند إعادة البيع، وتشكيلة هائلة من الطرازات تناسب مختلف الأسواق. هذه المنظومة جعلت اسم الصانع الياباني مرادف للثقة لدى ملايين العملاء حول العالم.
هل يستطيع الصينيون إسقاط الإمبراطورية اليابانية؟ الإجابة ليست سهلة. إذ تحقق الشركات الصينية تقدم مذهل في مجالات التكنولوجيا والسيارات الكهربائية والأسعار التنافسية، وهي تقترب بسرعة من كبار الصنّاع. لكن تُدرك جيداً أن المحافظة على الصدارة لا تتحقق بالأرقام وحدها. الأرباح، رضا العملاء، والثقة طويلة الأمد، تمثّل جميعها عوامل حاسمة في المعركة المقبلة.
ختاماً، وفي الوقت الذي يواصل فيه المنافسون الصينيون هجومهم العالمي، ترفع تويوتا شعار واضح:
“قد تتمكن من بناء سيارة سريعة أو متطورة، لكن بناء سمعة قائمة على الاعتمادية والثقة يحتاج إلى عقود من العمل”.
وكأنها تقول: “الثبات يا صديقي، الثبات.. والإيمان بقدراتك.. يمنحك الوصول والنجاح دوماً”..

title: The 771-HP Bentley Flying Spur Is Built for Drivers Who’ve Got the Dough and Love to Go-Go-Go
author: Drew Dorian
text:
2027 Bentley Flying Spur
- Sports-sedan attitude in a full-size luxury car, powerful hybrid powertrains, endless personalization options.
- Big ol' price tag, electric-to-gas propulsion handoff could use some refinement.
- Unlike its much softer Rolls-Royce rival, Bentley's Flying Spur is best experienced from the driver's seat.
For Sale Near You
See all results for new 2027 Bentley Flying Spur for sale near m6c 1c7
Overview
While other ultra-luxury sedans prioritize comfort and quietude, the 2027 Bentley Flying Spur takes a different tack, delivering sports-sedan fun and supercar acceleration. All models are plug-in hybrids, with top-spec variants pumping out 771 horsepower. If you're driving gently, the Flying Spur can cruise up to 30 miles on electric power alone.
The cabin combines old-world extravagance and modern tech, with crisp display screens mingling with gorgeous wood trim and fragrant leather upholstery. In our opinion, the best seat in the house is the driver's, given the Flying Spur's sporting intentions; however, the rear seat is still set up to cater to the chauffeured, with plenty of posh amenities including available massaging cushions and wood-veneer tray tables.
Expert Tip: If you don't need the rear seat, consider the two-door Continental GT, which offers similar performance with the added cachet of a coupe or convertible body.
What's New for 2027?
Although the Flying Spur was freshened just two years ago, Bentley has updated it yet again with new headlamps, a revised front bumper, and tweaks to the trunklid and taillamps. A mid-range S trim joins the lineup with more aggressive styling details and an adaptive suspension tuned for better handling. A Virtuoso Collection of Flying Spurs is available this year too, each with unique color themes—Soprano, Tenor, and Bass—and each featuring a special version of the Naim for Mulliner hi-fi audio system with 21 speakers. Dark Teal is a new color that joins the options sheet for 2027.
What's Your Car Worth?
Car and Driver calculates your car's value in three free and easy steps - using the same Black Book® data dealers use to appraise vehicles.
Pricing and Which One to Buy
Engine, Transmission, and Performance
- Hybrid Powertrain: twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 and one electric motor, 671 hp combined, twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 and one electric motor, 771 hp combined
- Transmission: 8-speed automatic
- Drivetrain: all-wheel-drive
All Flying Spurs are powered by a plug-in hybrid powertrain borrowed from the Continental GT coupe and convertible. It pairs a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 engine with an electric motor and a decent-sized battery, so acceleration feels effortless even under light throttle. The base, Azure, and S trims make 671 horsepower while Speed and Mulliner models get boosted to a whopping 771 ponies—the same output as in the Continental GT Speed.
Save for an occasional uncouth tremor when the V-8 kicks on to aid the electric motor, the hybrid system is both smooth and powerful. An eight-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and all-wheel drive are both standard, as is a rear-wheel steering system, which helps give the Flying Spur a surprisingly agile feel, particularly when maneuvering the big barge at low speeds.
An adaptive suspension system with air springs and dual-valve dampers provides a wide range of settings. From our experience with recent versions of this generation of Flying Spurs, in comfort mode, it glides over road imperfections with very little intrusion into the cabin. But in sport mode, the suspension firms up and turns this limo into a surprisingly good imitation of a sports sedan.
0–60-MPH Times
- C/D 60-mph Test: 3.0 seconds (Speed)
In Comparison: In our testing, the Flying Spur Speed sprinted to 60 mph in 3.0 seconds. That's a bit slower than the Continental GT coupe, but still mighty impressive for a huge hybrid luxury sedan. We haven't yet tested the 671-hp version, but we expect it to be a few ticks behind.
Range, Charging, and Battery Life
- EPA EV Range: 30 miles
An onboard battery pack is said to provide enough juice for 30 miles of driving range per charge, based on the EPA's estimate. An 11-kW charger is standard, and Bentley says the battery can be charged from zero to 100 percent in a little under three hours on the right connection.
Fuel Economy and Real-World MPG
- EPA City Rating: 17 mpg
- EPA Highway Rating: 22 mpg
The EPA estimates that the Flying Spur is good for 17 mpg city, 22 mpg highway, and 19 mpg combined. The Flying Spur's chief rival—the Rolls-Royce Ghost—doesn't fare any better at the pump, but we suspect that for buyers in this class, fuel efficiency isn’t a concern. For more information about the Flying Spur's fuel economy, visit the EPA's website.
Interior, Comfort, and Cargo
First Row: Sumptuous leather, rich wood trim, and beautifully wrought metal accents dress the Flying Spur's interior. Bentley's interior designers managed to preserve the brand's prim and proper styling while incorporating modern tech features.
Second Row: There's plenty of space for adults to stretch out and enjoy the luxurious environs in the back seat. A remote touchscreen controller mounted to the rear of the center console allows rear-seat riders to open and close the window shades, adjust the cabin climate, and activate the rear-seat massagers.
Cargo Capacity: A generously sized trunk offers plenty of space for luggage, cases of champagne, or a day's worth of impulse shopping on Rodeo Drive.
Infotainment and Connectivity
- Infotainment: 12.3-inch touchscreen
- Connectivity: Bluetooth, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Audio System: 10-speaker stereo (standard), 16-speaker Bang & Olufsen stereo (optional), 18-speaker Naim stereo (optional), 21-speaker Naim for Mulliner stereo (optional)
A large 12.3-inch infotainment touchscreen is situated between large swaths of wood trim on the Flying Spur's dashboard. For a price, Bentley will swap the static infotainment display screen for a powered setup that rotates the screen into the dashboard and brings up a wood panel featuring three analog dials (an outside temperature gauge, a clock, and a compass).
Passengers can connect to a Wi-Fi hotspot, and those with compatible smartphones will enjoy the Spur's wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. Bentley provides a 10-speaker stereo system standard, but will install one of three premium audio systems for more coin: either the 16-speaker Bang & Olufsen setup, the 18-speaker Naim system, or the 21-speaker Naim for Mulliner setup.
Safety and Driver-Assistance Features
Bentley offers several driver-assistance features; surprisingly, many of them cost extra.
- Standard Safety Features: automated emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, 360-degree exterior camera system
- Optional Safety Features: adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, night vision
For information about the Flying Spur’s crash-test results, visit the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) websites.
Warranty and Maintenance Coverage
Bentley offers a three-year warranty with the purchase of a new model, but unlike plans from more mainstream luxury brands, there's no mileage limit. Rolls-Royce offers a similar service and four years of coverage. Furthermore, Rolls-Royce offers four years of complimentary scheduled maintenance while Bentley covers only one.

- Powertrain Warranty: three years and unlimited miles
